command:
set -euo pipefail
ROOT=/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual
TMP=$(mktemp -d /tmp/go-eye-quiesced-v3.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT
git clone -q --depth 1 --branch chatgpt-work/avatar-eye-identity-canonical-mask-20260912 https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/clay-global-research-entity.git "$TMP/repo"
DIR="$TMP/repo/research_entity/avatar_eye_identity"
python3 "$DIR/test_validate_matched_eye_quiesced_ab.py"
HEAD=$(git -C "$TMP/repo" rev-parse HEAD); echo BRANCH_HEAD=$HEAD
SHADOW="$ROOT/.go_evidence/eye_semantic_shadow5/buehne.shadow.html"
OUT="$ROOT/.go_evidence/eye_quiesced_ab_v3_20260912_0912"
test -f "$SHADOW"; test ! -e "$OUT"
BEFORE=$(sha256sum "$ROOT/buehne.html" | awk '{print $1}')
python3 "$DIR/validate_matched_eye_quiesced_ab.py" --visual-root "$ROOT" --shadow "$SHADOW" --out "$OUT" --http-port 9276 --cdp-port 9277 | tee "$ROOT/.go_evidence/eye_quiesced_ab_v3_20260912_0912.stdout.json"
AFTER=$(sha256sum "$ROOT/buehne.html" | awk '{print $1}')
test "$BEFORE" = "$AFTER"
cat "$OUT/report.json"
echo LIVE_SHA=$AFTER
echo SCOPE=REAL_BROWSER_FULL_RUNTIME_QUIESCENCE_CANONICAL_EYE_AB_V3_NO_LIVE_WRITE
